title: Subtraction instruction phases
statement: For natural numbers $a,b,f$, a register $q$ among fifteen registers, a label $e$, a function $m$ assigning a label to each of three phases, and a phase $j$, define an instruction as follows: at phase $0$, test whether $q$ is zero, continuing to $e$ if so and to phase $1$ otherwise; at phase $1$, decrement $q$ and continue to phase $2$; at phase $2$, decrement register $11$ and return to phase $0$.
